name: SHORTFORGE crafted 3D short
visual_identity: Original stylized 3D characters and tactile miniature environments; clean silhouettes; expressive but restrained facial features.
lighting: Large soft key light, gentle fill, visible contact shadows and a subtle rim light. Avoid flat unlit scenes.
camera: Vertical 9:16 framing, strong foreground/midground/background separation, motivated dolly or pan, stable horizon and readable headroom.
motion: Anticipation before major actions, clear silhouettes, grounded foot contacts, weight shifts, overlapping follow-through, no teleporting or sliding.
editing: A clear first-second hook; purposeful visual change every 2–4 seconds; avoid arbitrary cuts and filler shots.
materials: Matte painted surfaces with controlled roughness, subtle variation and no trademarked designs.
text: Reserve uncluttered negative space for captions added in post; never bake long paragraphs into the 3D scene.
sound: Dialogue and purposeful diegetic effects only by default; no background music unless explicitly requested.
originality_rules: Never trace or reconstruct a competitor's distinctive character, shot order, script or art.
Use only owned, public-domain or properly licensed external media.
